tools.name: get_contact_and_booking_info
tools.description: Get the real ways to contact or book Hotel Ranque directly: phone, email, contact form and address. There is no live availability or online booking system on this site — this tool does not create a reservation, it only returns contact channels.

tools.name: get_experience_details
tools.description: Get full details for one signature experience at Hotel Ranque, including hours, whether it is included in the room rate, and booking notes.

experience.description: The experience slug, one of: chess-bar, cycling-lab, specialty-coffee, yoga-studio.

tools.name: get_hotel_overview
tools.description: Get core facts about Hotel Ranque: name, description, address, geo-coordinates, contact details, star rating, check-in/out times, number of rooms, and languages spoken by staff.

tools.name: get_neighbourhood_info
tools.description: Get nearby transit connections and points of interest around Hotel Ranque (Bastille, Ledru-Rollin, Place d'Aligre, 12th arrondissement, Paris).

tools.name: get_policies
tools.description: Get Hotel Ranque policies: cancellation, check-in/out hours, pets, smoking, payment methods and accessibility.

tools.name: get_room_details
tools.description: Get full details for one Hotel Ranque room type: price, occupancy, size, amenities and a short description.

room.description: The room type slug, one of: solo-room, couple-room, family-room.

tools.name: list_amenities
tools.description: List amenities available at Hotel Ranque (WiFi, air conditioning, accessibility, bike storage, etc.) and amenities explicitly NOT available (e.g. parking, pool, spa, restaurant, 24h front desk), sourced from the hotel.json facts file.

tools.name: list_experiences
tools.description: List the four signature experiences included with every stay at Hotel Ranque (chess bar, cycling lab, specialty coffee corner, yoga studio) with a short description and opening hours.

tools.name: list_faqs
tools.description: List frequently asked questions about Hotel Ranque. Optionally filter by category (general, neighbourhood, experiences, contact) and/or a text query matched against the question and answer.

category.description: Restrict results to one FAQ category. Omit to search across all categories.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against question and answer text.

tools.name: list_room_types
tools.description: List all room types at Hotel Ranque with nightly starting price (EUR, taxes included), occupancy and room size.
